chapter.verse: Hih thute a vekin mite' zakna ah a gen khit ciangin Capernaum khua ah Jesu lut hi.
Tu-in galkap za-uk bu khat in sila a pahtak mahmah khat nei a, tua silapa si dek zahin cina hi.
Jesu' thu a zak ciangin bupa in Jesu hong pai-in a silapa hong damsak nading a va thum dingin Jew makaite sawl hi.
Amaute Jesu' kiangah a tun uh ciangin nakpitak thum uh a, "Bupa pen nangma' huh dingin kilawm kituak hi.
A hang pen amah in i minam hong it a, i vengkhawm inn zong hong lamsak hi," ci uh hi.
Jesu zong amaute tawh pai hi. Bupa' inn a tun kuan uh ciangin bupa in a lawmte Jesu' kiangah sawl a, "Topa aw, kigimsak dah in. A hang pen ka innkhum nuai-ah nong lenglat ding ka kilawm kei hi.
Nang' kiangah hong pai dingin zong kilawm ka kisa tuankei hi. Tua ahih manin thupiak kam khat lokhia ziau inla ka sawltangzangpa damsak in.

A hang pen keimahmah zong ka nuai-a galkapte tawh ukna nuai-a om khat ka hi a, khat' kiangah, 'Va pai in,' ci le-ing va pai-in a dang khat' kiangah, 'Hong pai in,' ci le-ing hong pai hi. Ka silapa' kiangah, 'Hih sem in,' ci le-ing sem hi," cisak hi.
Hih thute Jesu in a zak ciangin bupa lamdang sa mahmah a, amah a zui mihonpi' lamah kihei-in, "Ke'n kong cihin ah Israel minam sung nangawn ah hih bang upna ka mu naikei hi," ci hi.
A kisawlte inn a tunkik uh ciangin silapa cidamin om mu uh hi.
Tua khit a sawt lo-in Nain a kici khua khat ah Jesu pai a, ama' nungzuite leh mihonpi zong amah tawh tonkhawm hi.

Khua kongpi a tun kuan uh ciangin, en un, mi a si khin khat hong kipua hi. Tua misi pen meigong numei khat ii tapa neihsun hi a, khuasung pan mihon a tamkhop khat zong meigongnu tawh hong tonkhawm uh hi.
Topa in meigongnu a muh ciangin hehpihhuai sa a, "Kap kei in," ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin pai-in misi zawnna taal va lawng a, a puate zong khawl uh hi. Tua ciangin, "Tangvalpa aw, thu kong pia hi, tho in!" ci hi.
Misipa zong tuto-in hong pau hi. Tua ciangin Jesu in a nu' kiangah ap hi.
Mi khempeuh launa tawh kidim uh a, "Eite lakah kamsang thupi khat hong piang ta! Pasian a mite' kiangah hong hawh ta!" ci-in Pasian phat uh hi.
Tua ciangin Judea gam bup leh a kimkot mun khempeuh ah Jesu' thu kizel hi.
John' nungzuite in hih thute khempeuh ama' kiangah a gen uh ciangin John in a nungzuite nih samin
Topa' kiangah sawl a, "Nang pen a hong pai dingpa na hi hiam? Ahihkeileh a dang khat ka lamen lai ding uh hiam?" ci-in dongsak hi.

Tua mite Jesu' kiangah a tun uh ciangin, "Baptizepa John in kote nang' kiangah hong sawlin, 'Nang pen a hong pai dingpa na hi hiam? Ahihkeileh a dang khat ka lamen lai ding uh hiam?' ci-in hong dongsak hi," ci uh hi.
Tua hunlenai sung mahin Jesu in cinate, nattom natsau leh kha gilo veite tampitak damsak a, khuamulo tampitak hehpihin khua musak hi.

Tua ciangin Jesu in thudongte hih bangin dawng hi: "Na muh na zak uh thute John' kiangah va gen un: Khuamulote in khua mu, khelbaite lampai, vun natna veitea kisiangsak, khuazalote in khua za-in misite thokik a, mizawngte' tungah Lungdamna Thu kitangko hi.
Kei' hangin lungnopmawhna a neilo mi thuphangah ahi hi."

John' kamtaite a paikhiat khit uh ciangin Jesu in mihonpi' kiangah John' thu hih bangin gen hi: "Gamgawtak lakah na pusuahkhiat uh, bang en ding na hi uh hiam? Huih' mut-a kihuang ngiaingiai pumpeng kungte hiam?
Hilo ahihleh bang en dinga pusuakkhia na hi uh hiam? Puannel a silh mipa hiam? En un, puansilh a thupi tawh kizemin a nop-omte pen kumpi inn sungah om uh hi.
Tua ci lehang bang en dinga pusuakkhia na hi uh hiam? Kamsang hiam? Hi hi. Ke'n kong cihin ah kamsang khat sangin lianzaw hi.
Ama' thu hih bangin kigelh hi: "'En un, nangma' mai ah ka kamsangpa ka sawl a, amah in nang' ma-in na lampi sialkhol ding hi.'"
"Ke'n kong cihin ah numei' sungpan suakte lakah John' sangin a thupizaw om lo hi. Himah taleh Pasian' kumpigam sunga a neu khat nangawn John' sangin thupizaw lai hi."
(Hih thu a zak uh ciangin siahdongte-a kipan mi khempeuh in John' baptizena sang uh a, Pasian dik ci-in pulak uh hi.
Ahih hangin Pharisee-te leh thukhun hilhcian syate in amau' adinga Pasian' geelsakna nialin John' baptizena sang lo uh hi.)d
"Tua hi a, hih khanghun mite bang tawh ka genteh thei ding hiam? Bang tawh kibang uh hiam?
Sumbuktual ah a tu, hih bangin khatlekhat a kisam, naupangte tawh kibang uh hi: "'Tamngai kong tum uh a, na laam tuankei uh hi;
"A hang pen Baptizepa John anlum ne lo lengtui dawn lo-in hong pai ciangin note in, 'Amah'n dawilawm nei!' na ci uh hi.
Mihing' Tapa anne tuidawnin hong pai ciangin note in, 'En dih un! Anhai zuhaipa, siahdongte leh mawhneite' lawmpa!' na ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin pilna cih pen ama' sepkhiatte tawh a maanna kilang hi."
Pharisee-te khat in an nekhawm dingin kho ahih manin Jesu zong tua Pharisee mipa' inn ah pai-in anne dingin tu hi.
Tua laitak, en un, tua khua-a mawhnei numei khat in Pharisee mipa' inn ah Jesu anne-in om cih a theih ciangin alabaster suangngo thawle khat tawh nilhthau hong tawi hi.
Jesu' nungah dingin kap a, a khitui taak tawh Jesu' khe a kawtsak khit ciangin a lu tunga a sam tawh nulin a khete namin nilhthau tawh zutsak hi.

Jesu a sam inntek Pharisee mipa in a muh ciangin amahmah kiho a, "Numeinu mawhnei khat ahih manin hih mipa kamsang khat ahih takpi leh amah a lawngnu kua hi-a bangci nam cih thei khin ding hi," ci hi.
Jesu in amah dawng a, "Simon aw, kong gen ding khat om hi," a cih leh Simon in, "Sya aw, hong gen in," ci hi.
Jesu in, "Sumleitawi piapa' tungah leiba nei mi nih om hi. Khat in denariusf za-nga ba a, a khat in sawmnga ba hi.
Leiba loh zolo uh ahih manin sumleitawi piapa in amaute gel a leiba uh maisak hi. Tua ci lehang a kua pen in amah itzaw ding hiam?" ci-in dong hi.
Simon in, "Leiba tam a kimaisakpa hidingin ka ummawh hi," ci hi. Jesu in, "Maantak na khen hi," ci hi.

Tua ciangin Jesu in numeinu lam kihei kawmin Simon' kiangah hih bangin gen hi: "Hih numei na mu hiam? Na inn sung kong lut ciangin ka khesil nadingin tui nong pia a, ahi zongin amah in a khitui tawh ka khe kawtsakin a sam tawh nul hi.
Nang'n nong nam kei a, ahi zongin amah in kong lut-a kipan ka khe a nap khawl nailo hi.
Ka lu nilhthau nong nilhsak kei a, ahi zongin amah in ka khe nilhthau hong zutsak hi.
Tua hi a, kong cihin ah numeinu a mawhna tampite kimaisak ahih manin nakpi-in hong it hi. Ahih hangin tawm bek a kimaisakte in tawm bek hong it uh hi."
Tua ciangin numeinu' kiangah, "Na mawhnate hong kimaisakzo hi," ci hi.
Sabuai ah Jesu tawh a tukhawm mite khatlekhat kiho uh a, "Mawhna nangawn a maisak hih mipa, kua ahi hiam?" ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in numeinu' kiangah, "Na upna in nang hong honkhia khinzo hi. Lungnuamin pai in," ci hi.Jesu A Tonpih Numeite
